description:
This is the .NET Client API for the AVACloud service. An online converter for
      GAEB, Excel, Oenorm, REB DA11, custom formats and more around tendering & invoicing.
      Find out more at www.dangl-it.com
releaseNotes:
# Changelog

You can find the full changelog at [DanglDocu](https://docs.dangl-it.com).

## v1.68.0:
- Added opt-in compact JSON responses via `preserveReferences=true` for conversion endpoints returning a top-level `ProjectDto`. Shared objects, such as item number schemas, are serialized once with `$id` metadata and referenced via `$ref`. Clients must support reference-aware deserialization; default responses remain unchanged. Compact responses omit empty collections, null entries in `Elements`, and propagated price-component and catalogue properties where authoritative data is retained elsewhere. The normal DTO -> Dangl.AVA domain -> DTO conversion restores propagated properties and recalculates prices. Child-specific overrides of omitted properties are not retained
- Fixed an issue in REB to AVA conversions where helper lines and intermediate sums were sometimes not calculated correctly

## v1.67.1:
- Added an option to specify to disable price rounding when converting an AVA Wrapper to a PDF file

## v1.67.0:
- Fixed a bug in the project validation where, when at least one item number was duplicated, all item numbers were recognized as duplicates, even if they were not duplicates themselves
- Added new properties to the AVA model that contain ÖNorm-specific data. The previous LB reference data should no longer be accessed in the form of catalogue references but instead can be found directly in `ServiceSpecificationOenormProperties`. For backwards compatibility, the catalogue references are still available. When exporting, the new properties are used if present, otherwise **AVACloud** falls back to the legacy catalogue references
- Added a new option to specify the target phase when exporting to ÖNorm files
- When importing ÖNorm files, by default now the structure declared in the file is taken for the item number generation. This is most likely always what is intended, and it improves performance when importing ÖNorm files, especially larger ones, by a lot. To opt in to the previous behavior, the setting can be explicitly disabled
- The .NET AVACloud client libraries are now signed with an Authenticode certificate

## v1.66.0:
- The Invoice PDF embedding was updated. When a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD invoice is embedded into a PDF, the invoice is now properly designated as having the XRechnung profile and the required Factur-X XML metadata is added to the PDF as well

## v1.65.1:
- Added support for X31 files in GAEB XML V3.4 format for both import and export in the REB endpoints

## v1.65.0:
- Added support for the new GAEB XML v3.4 standard. This is currently not yet tested with any real integration tests, since we have not yet received v3.4 files from other apps. New properties supported are the sustainability elements in `ServiceSpecification` and `Position`
- The ÖNorm import handling was updated. If files specify price components, then all positions imported are marked with `PriceCompositionRequired=true` upon import

## v1.64.0:
- Added `UseOenormFileDeclarationForItemNumberSchema` when importing an Oenorm file. Setting this parameter to `true` will now make AVACloud generate an item number schema based strictly on the structure definition in the file, and will not be affected by the actual elements structure in the file
- The backend was updated to .NET 10

## v1.63.8:
- Fixed a bug where some properties that were not valid in X86 were also removed from X83 exports in cases where the original `AVA.Project` was originating from an X86 import file

## v1.63.6:
- Added an option to disable source comments in XRechnung exports. By default, AVACloud will add a comment to the exported XRechnung XML files that indicates that the file was created with AVACloud. This can now be disabled by setting the `DisableBrandingComment` query parameter to `true` when exporting XRechnung files

## v1.63.0:
- Added a new endpoint that allows merging XRechnung invoices into PDF files as attachments. This is useful to create FacturX / ZUGFeRD invoices that contain the XRechnung XML as embedded file
- AVACloud can now also directly import PDF files with XRechnung attachments via the existing XRechnung import endpoint

## v1.62.0:
- Added a new endpoint that allows merging two AVA projects. This can be used to merge e.g. prices from a received offer into an existing project structure

## v1.61.1:
- The Docker images now use a non-root user `avaclouduser` with `uid=10001` to run AVACloud by default. This does not apply to ARM based images

## v1.61.0:
- AVACloud can now also do basic validation for GAEB 90 files
- Some bugfixes when handling XRechnung files
- The .NET clients no longer have a strong name / are no longer signed, to avoid issues when used in projects that do not use strong naming

## v1.60.12:
- Added `Position.IsMainPosition` as a new property

## v1.60.11:
- Added `DisablePriceRounding` as option for endpoints that create XRechnung files. With this option, prices will no longer be rounded to two decimal places

## v1.60.5:
- Update dependencies

## v1.60.4:
- Changed the `DisableItemNumberIdentifierTransformations` option when importing GAEB files. For GAEB XML source files, this option now only results in non-numerical tiers in the item numbers to be left as-is, numerical tiers will always be left-padded with zeroes to match the schema. This is to ensure that item numbers are always schema compliant, while still allowing to import item numbers that have non-numerical tiers as-is. This change is backwards compatible, but may result in different item numbers being imported than before if the source files contained non-numerical tiers and this option was enabled

## v1.60.3:
- The `ItemNumberSchemaTierDto.Alignment` property was made optional. It will still default to `ItemNumberSchemaTierAlignmentDto.Undefined` as an enum value when creating new instances, and will always have a value when returned from the API

## v1.60.1:
- Fixed a regression introduced with v1.60.0. Now, the ´ShortText` property correctly has precedence over the `HtmlShortText` property again, ensuring backwards compatibility. If you want to work with the `HtmlShortText` property, please ensure that `ShortText` is set to `null` when sending data to AVACloud

## v1.60.0:
- Added `HtmlShortText` to `IDescription` elements (`Position`, `NoteText` and `SubDescription`). This is in behavior similar to `HtmlLongText`, setting this will override the `ShortText` property. This can be used to transport text additions in short texts
- Added `DisableItemNumberIdentifierTransformations` as option when importing GAEB files. Enabling this will import the item numbers directly as-is from the GAEB file, without adjustments like padding with zeroes. This allows to preserve the item numbers exactly as given in the GAEB files, even if they are not schema compliant
